page.layout: One printed page. Running head centred at top, page number top right. Heading block centred below. Below it a diagram (synopsis with braces) with boxes and right-hand descriptive column. Faint fragments of the facing left page at the far left edge, not transcribed. Catchword "E" and "Respi-" at lower right of the diagram.

main_text.head: DE SPECIEBVS AROMATICIS siue confectionibus, unam quamlibet partem roborantibus. Tab. 5.
main_text.l: Apoplexiae, epilepsiae, et affectibus melancholicis medetur.
Ad thoracis et pulmonum vitia, ut sputa leta, crassa, in pectoralibus contenta.

page.notes: Tab. 5 is the table number in the heading. The diagram's left labels Caput and Thorace are set vertically/angled in print; the word "Respiciunt" is set vertically along the left brace. Some words in the diagram are italic. Faint printing on the left page edge is not transcribed. The catchword "Respi-" is the start of the next page's text.
